steps.name: environment: persist NODE_ENV, compute npm global bin at source-time, detect and persist PKG_MANAGER and TYPE
steps.description: Prepare workspace logs, write /etc/profile.d/frontend_env.sh which computes npm prefix and appends its bin to PATH at source-time, export NODE_ENV=development. Detect installed node/npm/yarn versions using robust node-based comparisons, but only fail on truly incompatible runtime (Node <18 or npm <9). Persist deterministic PKG_MANAGER and TYPE to WORKSPACE/.project_env so other steps are consistent. Source the profile for the current run and validate PATH and node/npm availability. Minimal sudo usage (only for /etc/profile.d write).
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-book-310206-310325/FrontendApplication"
LOGDIR="$WORKSPACE/.setup_logs"; sudo mkdir -p /etc/profile.d && mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" "$LOGDIR"
LOG="$LOGDIR/env-001.log"
# write profile that computes npm prefix at source-time and sets NODE_ENV
sudo tee /etc/profile.d/frontend_env.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
# FrontendApplication environment (evaluated when sourced)
export NODE_ENV=development
# compute npm prefix at source time (when this file is sourced)
_npm_prefix() { /usr/bin/env bash -lc "npm config get prefix 2>/dev/null || echo '/usr/local'"; }
export PATH="$(_npm_prefix)/bin:$PATH"
EOF
sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/frontend_env.sh
# source it for current non-login shell and verify
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source /etc/profile.d/frontend_env.sh || true
mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"
# detect versions and perform robust checks using node -e
NODE_V=$(node -v 2>/dev/null || echo "")
NPM_V=$(npm -v 2>/dev/null || echo "")
YARN_V=$(yarn -v 2>/dev/null || echo "")
timestamp(){ date -Is || date +"%s"; }
printf "%s %s\n" "$(timestamp)" "node=$NODE_V npm=$NPM_V yarn=$YARN_V" >"$LOG"
# semantic compare using node -e to avoid sort issues
check_ge(){ node -e "const v=process.argv[1].replace(/^v/,'').split('.').map(Number);const r=process.argv[2].split('.').map(Number);for(let i=0;i<3;i++){if((v[i]||0)>(r[i]||0)){process.exit(0);} if((v[i]||0)<(r[i]||0)){process.exit(1);} }process.exit(0);" "$1" "$2"; }
INCOMPAT=0
if [ -z "$NODE_V" ] || ! check_ge "$NODE_V" "18.0.0"; then echo "$(timestamp) node version $NODE_V < required 18.0.0" >>"$LOG" && INCOMPAT=1; fi
if [ -z "$NPM_V" ] || ! check_ge "$NPM_V" "9.0.0"; then echo "$(timestamp) npm version $NPM_V < required 9.0.0" >>"$LOG" && INCOMPAT=1; fi
# do not abort entire setup for minor mismatches; abort only if incompatible
if [ $INCOMPAT -eq 1 ]; then echo "$(timestamp) incompatible runtime detected; aborting env-001" >>"$LOG" && exit 3; fi
# determine deterministic package manager and TYPE; prefer lockfile, then installed binary
PKG_MANAGER="npm"
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/yarn.lock" ]; then PKG_MANAGER="yarn"; elif [ -f "$WORKSPACE/package-lock.json" ]; then PKG_MANAGER="npm"; elif command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then PKG_MANAGER="yarn"; fi
# infer TYPE from existing tsconfig or package.json
TYPE="js"
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/tsconfig.json" ]; then TYPE="ts"; else
  if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/package.json" ]; then TYPE=$(node -e "try{const p=require('$WORKSPACE/package.json');const deps=Object.assign({},p.dependencies||{},p.devDependencies||{});console.log((deps.typescript||deps['@types/react']||0)?'ts':'js')}catch(e){console.log('js')}")
  fi
fi
# persist project env for other scripts
cat > "$WORKSPACE/.project_env" <<EOF
PKG_MANAGER=$PKG_MANAGER
TYPE=$TYPE
EOF
printf "%s %s\n" "$(timestamp)" "pkg_manager=$PKG_MANAGER TYPE=$TYPE" >>"$LOG"
exit 0

check_ge(){ node -e "const v=process.argv[1].replace(/^v/,'').split('.').map(Number);const r=process.argv[2].split('.').map(Number);for(let i=0;i<3;i++){if((v[i]||0)>(r[i]||0)){process.exit(0);} if((v[i]||0)<(r[i]||0)){process.exit(1);} }process.exit(0);" "$1" "$2"; }

elif [ -f "$WORKSPACE/package-lock.json" ]; then PKG_MANAGER="npm";
elif command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then PKG_MANAGER="yarn"; fi
# infer TYPE from existing tsconfig or package.json
TYPE="js"
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/tsconfig.json" ]; then TYPE="ts";
else
  if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/package.json" ]; then

cat > "$WORKSPACE/.project_env" <<EOF
PKG_MANAGER=$PKG_MANAGER

steps.name: scaffolding: safe create-react-app scaffold (temp dir), honor PKG_MANAGER and TYPE and validate artifacts
steps.description: If a React project already exists in WORKSPACE, skip. Otherwise read WORKSPACE/.project_env for PKG_MANAGER and TYPE, scaffold into a temporary directory using create-react-app (fallback to npx) without forcing package manager; if the chosen manager is yarn but CRA used npm, convert immediately (yarn import). Copy files into WORKSPACE with controlled merge (do not overwrite existing files silently). Validate that package.json, public/index.html, and src entry exist after copy; fail early with logs if missing. Create minimal .eslintrc.json and .prettierrc only if absent.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-book-310206-310325/FrontendApplication"
LOG="$WORKSPACE/.setup_logs/scaffold-002.log"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" && mkdir -p "$(dirname "$LOG")"
# load persisted project env
PKG_MANAGER="npm"; TYPE="js"
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/.project_env" ]; then source "$WORKSPACE/.project_env" || true; fi
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# detect existing react app markers
if [ -f package.json ]; then
  if node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json');const deps=Object.assign({},p.dependencies||{},p.devDependencies||{});if(deps.react||deps['react-scripts']||deps.vite) process.exit(0);}catch(e){} process.exit(1)" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf "%s already has a React project, skipping scaffold\n" "$WORKSPACE" >"$LOG"
    exit 0
  fi
fi
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d -t cra-scaffold-XXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMPDIR"' EXIT
TEMPLATE=""; [ "${TYPE}" = "ts" ] && TEMPLATE="--template typescript"
# use installed create-react-app when available
if command -v create-react-app >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  (cd "$TMPDIR" && create-react-app . $TEMPLATE) >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { printf "CRA failed (see %s)\n" "$LOG" >&2; exit 5; }
else
  (cd "$TMPDIR" && npx --yes create-react-app@latest . $TEMPLATE) >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { printf "npx CRA failed (see %s)\n" "$LOG" >&2; exit 6; }
fi
# if preferred PKG_MANAGER is yarn but scaffold produced package-lock.json, convert
if [ "$PKG_MANAGER" = "yarn" ] && [ -f "$TMPDIR/package-lock.json" ] && command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then (cd "$TMPDIR" && yarn import >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); fi
# copy scaffolded files into workspace without destroying existing files: copy only missing or update package.json merge
shopt -s dotglob
for f in "$TMPDIR"/* "$TMPDIR"/.*; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || continue
  base=$(basename "$f")
  # skip . and ..
  [ "$base" = "." ] || [ "$base" = ".." ] || true
  if [ ! -e "$WORKSPACE/$base" ]; then cp -a "$f" "$WORKSPACE/"; fi
done
# merge package.json scripts if package.json exists in both
if [ -f "$TMPDIR/package.json" ]; then
  if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/package.json" ]; then
    node -e "const fs=require('fs');const a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('$WORKSPACE/package.json'));const b=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('$TMPDIR/package.json'));a.scripts=Object.assign({},b.scripts||{},a.scripts||{});a.dependencies=Object.assign({},b.dependencies||{},a.dependencies||{});fs.writeFileSync('$WORKSPACE/package.json',JSON.stringify(a,null,2))"
  else
    cp -a "$TMPDIR/package.json" "$WORKSPACE/"
  fi
fi
# validate essential artifacts
if [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/package.json" ] || [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/public/index.html" ] || ( [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/src/index.js" ] && [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/src/index.tsx" ] ); then
  printf "%s missing scaffold artifacts after copy (see %s)\n" "$WORKSPACE" "$LOG" >>"$LOG"
  exit 7
fi
# ensure package.json has start/build/test scripts
node -e "const fs=require('fs');let p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('$WORKSPACE/package.json'));p.scripts=p.scripts||{};p.scripts.start=p.scripts.start||'react-scripts start';p.scripts.build=p.scripts.build||'react-scripts build';p.scripts.test=p.scripts.test||'react-scripts test';fs.writeFileSync('$WORKSPACE/package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2))"
# minimal lint configs only if absent
[ -f "$WORKSPACE/.eslintrc.json" ] || cat > "$WORKSPACE/.eslintrc.json" <<'ESL'
{ "extends": ["react-app", "eslint:recommended"], "env": {"browser": true, "es2021": true} }
ESL
[ -f "$WORKSPACE/.prettierrc" ] || cat > "$WORKSPACE/.prettierrc" <<'PRE'
{ "singleQuote": true, "trailingComma": "es5" }
PRE
# persist chosen PKG_MANAGER and TYPE to project env
printf "PKG_MANAGER=%s\nTYPE=%s\n" "$PKG_MANAGER" "$TYPE" > "$WORKSPACE/.project_env"
printf "%s scaffold complete, pkg=%s type=%s\n" "$(date -Is)" "$PKG_MANAGER" "$TYPE" >>"$LOG"
exit 0

steps.name: dependencies: deterministic install of dependencies and devDependencies, ensure serve is available locally
steps.description: Read WORKSPACE/.project_env and choose package manager deterministically: prefer yarn.lock -> yarn, package-lock.json -> npm, else prefer installed binary. Persist chosen manager to WORKSPACE/.pkg_manager. Install dependencies with the chosen manager non-interactively. Ensure devDependencies eslint, prettier, jest and serve are present (install them if missing). Log versions and installation output to WORKSPACE/.setup_logs/deps-003.log. Do not mix npm and yarn in the same project.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-book-310206-310325/FrontendApplication"
LOG="$WORKSPACE/.setup_logs/deps-003.log"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.setup_logs"; touch "$LOG"
# load project env
PKG_ENV=""; TYPE="js"
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/.project_env" ]; then source "$WORKSPACE/.project_env" || true; fi
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# deterministic selection: lockfile preference then binary
PKG_MANAGER="npm"
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then PKG_MANAGER="yarn"; elif [ -f package-lock.json ]; then PKG_MANAGER="npm"; elif command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then PKG_MANAGER="yarn"; fi
# persist definitive choice
echo "PKG_MANAGER=$PKG_MANAGER" > "$WORKSPACE/.pkg_manager"
echo "$(date -Is) chosen_pkg=$PKG_MANAGER" >>"$LOG"
# install dependencies
if [ "$PKG_MANAGER" = "yarn" ]; then
  yarn install --silent >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "yarn install failed (see $LOG)" >&2; exit 8; }
else
  if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "npm ci failed (see $LOG)" >&2; exit 9; };
  else npm install --no-audit --no-fund --silent >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "npm install failed (see $LOG)" >&2; exit 10; };
  fi
fi
# determine missing dev deps and install locally (eslint, prettier, jest, serve)
MISSING=()
node -e "try{const fs=require('fs');const p=fs.existsSync('package.json')?JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json')):{};const deps=Object.assign({},p.dependencies||{},p.devDependencies||{});['eslint','prettier','jest','serve'].forEach(d=>{if(!deps[d])console.log(d)});}catch(e){}" | while read -r pkg; do MISSING+=("$pkg"); done
# convert bash array handling
if [ ${#MISSING[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  if [ "$PKG_MANAGER" = "yarn" ]; then
    yarn add -D --silent "${MISSING[@]}" >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "yarn add devDeps failed (see $LOG)" >&2; exit 11; }
  else
    npm i -D --no-audit --no-fund --silent "${MISSING[@]}" >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "npm install devDeps failed (see $LOG)" >&2; exit 12; }
  fi
fi
# log tool versions

SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 0.5

fi

if [ -n "$PGID" ]; then kill -- -"${PGID}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi

change_logs.message: Refined initial plan to address analyst HIGH/medium issues: modified env-001 to safely write /etc/profile.d/frontend_env.sh, compute and add npm global bin, and validate Node/npm versions; changed scaffold-002 to use create-react-app binary (not npx default), avoid overwriting existing eslint/prettier, log scaffold failures to WORKSPACE/.setup_logs; changed deps-003: corrected script_name to 'install', implemented deterministic install of missing devDependencies (eslint, prettier, jest) executing yarn or npm commands, and added minimal flags for non-interactive installs; updated test-004 to create JS or TS test file based on TYPE and to respect package.json test script; added start-006 script to run dev server in foreground for interactive usage (captures logs) and kept validation-005 to build and serve the production build via npx serve and perform robust polling and termination of the serve process. These changes address PATH expansion, idempotency, diagnostic logging, deterministic devDependency installs, correct script_name, test-file extension, and stable validation using built artifact.

Refined plan per analyst feedback: modified env-001 to (a) write /etc/profile.d/frontend_env.sh so PATH is expanded at source-time using command substitution inside the file, (b) enforce Node >=18 and npm >=9 with semantic checks and log detected versions, and (c) source the new profile for the current run. Modified scaffold-002 to scaffold into a temporary empty directory then move files into WORKSPACE (avoids in-place CRA issues), detect tsconfig.json to set TYPE, and guard create-react-app use with version check and fallback to npx. Updated deps-003 to consistently select package manager (yarn if yarn.lock or yarn present else npm), remove dead PKG_CMD, log the chosen manager and versions, and install appropriate TS test tooling only if TYPE=ts. Updated test-004 to prefer JS test for a guaranteed pass; if TYPE=ts and ts-jest is available or installed, run TS tests; test runner stdout+stderr are logged. Added a dedicated build step build-006 (script_name 'build') to run yarn build or npm run build deterministically. Updated validation-005 to depend on build-006 and to start the static server with setsid to create a process group, poll with a clear timeout, capture stdout+stderr to log, and kill the process group on completion. Adjusted start step to capture both stdout and stderr to the stated log and changed its category to 'start'. These changes address critical and high-level issues: package manager consistency, safe CRA scaffolding, TypeScript test handling, reliable server lifecycle, version checks, and idempotency.

Refined steps env-001, scaffold-002, deps-003, test-004, build-006, validate-005, and start-007 to address analyst feedback. Main changes: env-001 now writes a profile that computes npm prefix at source-time using an explicit shell-eval command, logs versions, performs robust semantic checks via node -e, and writes WORKSPACE/.project_env containing PKG_MANAGER and TYPE placeholders. scaffold-002 no longer forces --use-npm; it reads persisted package manager and TYPE from WORKSPACE/.project_env, scaffolds into a temp dir, copies files with controlled merge semantics, validates essential artifacts (package.json, public/index.html, src entry), and generates missing minimal lint configs. deps-003 deterministically selects package manager (lockfile preferred), writes WORKSPACE/.pkg_manager, installs dependencies consistently, ensures 'serve' is added as devDependency if missing, and logs clearly. test-004 detects test tooling by reading package.json devDependencies, creates a safe JS/TS smoke test accordingly, and runs tests via package.json scripts (npm/yarn) while logging runner and command. build-006 exports NODE_ENV=production, runs the build via chosen manager, and verifies build output presence. validate-005 avoids npx by using node_modules/.bin/serve (installing it earlier if needed), starts the server capturing PID and PGID robustly, increases startup timeout, performs HTTP smoke test and logs response on failure, then cleans up reliably. start-007 now exports NODE_ENV=development, reads PKG_MANAGER, and streams logs via tee to both console and WORKSPACE/.setup_logs/start-007.log. These changes fix command-substitution quoting, persist TYPE/PKG across steps, prevent package-manager mixing, improve scaffold safety, ensure deterministic builds/tests, and avoid network-dependent npx during validation.
